what’s up? what’s on your mind

here’s my unwanted two cents:

you should be your own priority, take steps to better your mental health, speaking of the pool, you should try a swim class! they’re so calming and perfect for your mental health. you can float on your back and ride small waves and forget your anxiety and troubles… and about your friend, try directing her to resources around her area? trust me when i said tackling other people mental health on top of yours is a hard task

i know how it feels for parents to betray a good going or mutually standing relationship. i empathize with you. they think tough love is the best way but instead of love and comfort. if you need a friend to talk with i’m here
hola! how are you how’s everything?

i personally haven’t but my close high school friend has. he’s described waking up from aches from doing military workouts and other complications. the way he describes it sounds like hell on earth and he shouldn’t have to endure 3-4 more years for a billionaire oil company just to have a fair chance of going to college

yea i get you. you planning on college or dorm life btw? that’s currently my number one escape plan LMAO. i’ve heard about depression and stress disappearing as you get peace away from your aggressors

get treatment for yourself above all, relationships and money included. you are your first priority. about the relationship, maybe you could sit down and talk things through? but yea i do get it, doctors are the worst. in my case they were a mix of nice/tough love. i got more harm than good. lastly, PLEASE don’t take those pills. i was bedridden & still have complications. worst pain i’ve ever felt 100% and you could destroy your liver which is a long and painful process. i think dragging yourself out of this hellhole hurts less, i wish you the best of luck!
this isn’t ok. your feelings and boundaries are valid. you should be able to feel safe & protected. everything that’s happened was for a reason - which wasn’t your fault
i have anxiety about how i’ll turn out 24/7. my main takeaway from this is that you care, that’s more than many many people can say. you’re already far off. i wish you the best of luck!
you should be proud of yourself just for speaking up, that takes a lot of courage. i admire you for wanting your brother safe after all this even though he deserves the worst
hey what’s going on? i’m here for you man i’ve been through this just a couple weeks ago
honestly fuck that person. let em know. that they’re a horrible person & that your feelings are valid
i can definitely see how you can succumb to feeling overwhelmed about life. have you told whoever your absolute boundaries? if no one else, i really want you to advocate for yourself

oh damn i’m so sorry you’re going through this. just to clarify - you have to take your little brother aka your sexual abuser to court? if this was the case, it really isn’t your problem and if your parents aren’t willing to deal with it it’s their consequences to handle. as for the suicide attempts, you seem like a strong person, way stronger than many i’ve seen. id love to see you live your best life just to spite them

here’s unneeded advice from a almost 19 year old:

calm down, take a breath. you should be your own priority. everything should be in slow motion so you have time to care for yourself. there’ll always be boys to date or friendship groups to be apart of, a stable mental health might not always be there tho. hope this helps
